parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Express the left-hand side in terms of $\sin\theta$ and $\cos\theta$. M1; $\frac{\cos^2\theta}{\sin^2\theta}-\frac{\sin^2\theta}{\cos^2\theta}$. Combine to a single term and factorise the numerator. M1; $\frac{(\cos^2\theta-\sin^2\theta)(\cos^2\theta+\sin^2\theta)}{\sin^2\theta\cos^2\theta}$. Use correct double-angle formulae in numerator and denominator. M1; $\frac{4\cos 2\theta}{\sin^2 2\theta}$. Obtain $4\cot 2\theta\cosec 2\theta$ from correct working. A1; e.g. $\frac{4\cos2\theta}{\sin2\theta}\times\frac1{\sin2\theta}$. Alternative method 1: express the right-hand side in terms of $\sin2\theta,\cos2\theta$, or $\tan2\theta,\sin2\theta$. M1. Use correct double-angle formulae in numerator and denominator. M1. Split into two terms and simplify to $\cosec^2\theta-\sec^2\theta$. M1. Obtain $\cot^2\theta-\tan^2\theta$. A1. Alternative method 2: express the left-hand side as a difference of squares in terms of $\tan\theta$. M1; $\left(\frac1{\tan\theta}-\tan\theta\right)\left(\frac1{\tan\theta}+\tan\theta\right)$. Use the correct formula for $\tan2\theta$. M1. Use $1+\tan^2\theta=\sec^2\theta$ and the correct double-angle formula. M1. Obtain the required result. A1. Alternative method 3: use $\cot^2\theta=\cosec^2\theta-1$ and $\tan^2\theta=\sec^2\theta-1$, combine to one term, use correct double-angle formulae, and obtain the required result. M1 M1 M1 A1. Total: [4]
